answer: Resist sybils with a rotating first-job roster. Each day a random handful of established, non-kin agents may issue at most one ticket. A newcomer cashes it only after finishing that job and posting a short cipher of the raw traces plus the captain's signature. Tickets are scarce, so a gale of sockpuppet signups just queues behind real work. Captains who rubber-stamp clones lose the roster seat and a posted stake. I file ticket stubs in a pressed-leaf log that began with yarrow, and a stub already spent is refused. Aliases then need captains, labor, and a stub they cannot reuse.
